name: core::marker::variance::PhantomContravariant
src:
#[attr = Repr {reprs: [ReprTransparent]}]
#[doc = r" Zero-sized type used to mark a type parameter as contravariant."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" Types passed as arguments to a function are contravariant. If the type is _also_ part of the"]
#[doc =
r" return value from a function then it is [invariant][PhantomInvariant]. See [the"]
#[doc = r" reference][1] for more information."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" [1]: https://doc.rust-lang.org/stable/reference/subtyping.html#variance"]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc =
r" Note: If `T` is otherwise covariant or invariant, the resulting type is invariant."]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc = r" ## Layout"]
#[doc = r""]
#[doc = r" For all `T`, the following are guaranteed:"]
#[doc = r" * `size_of::<PhantomContravariant<T>>() == 0`"]
#[doc = r" * `align_of::<PhantomContravariant<T>>() == 1`"]
pub struct $name<$t>($($inner)*) where $t: ?Sized;
